# Font Metadata

## Summary
The naming and classification tables of a font: family, weight, outlines and axes.

## Shape
Read from the sfnt `name`, `OS/2`, `head` and `maxp` tables, which OpenType and TrueType share —
which is why one field serves both, and why `outlineType` records the actual difference (CFF
versus quadratic). `isVariable` plus `axes` describe a variable font's design space. A WOFF
indexes with all of this available; a WOFF2 does not, because its Brotli-transformed `glyf` cannot
be recovered by inflating alone.

## Example
```ts
import { FontMetadataField } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/file-formats/metadata-fields';

@field metadata = contains(FontMetadataField);
```
